name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of northwest Argentina. The project hosts one of the world's largest undeveloped primary silver resources, with 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold in measured and indicated resources. The company has completed a Pre-Feasibility Study and received approval under Argentina's Large Investment incentive program, positioning it as a near-term development candidate.
